name: kodflow-hud
description: Optional heads-up display beside the status line, as a mod (function hooks, Claude Code 2.1.293 or later): a Tasks pane with the open epics of kodflow-hooks' task list as a tree (subtasks, blockers, the critical path, the worker, model and effort on each task, the time since it last moved, a silent flag, the tasks waiting on the person) or as a graph by state, driven by keys and clicks, a clicked row or tab never moving from under the pointer; an Agents tab, only while a subagent runs, with the main loop and each subagent apart (name, role, model, state, a frozen one flagged, the task it holds, its folder and the files it last read, wrote or committed), each in a colour of its own; tab titles that count the tasks left and the subagents at work, Tâches shown at start, `a` and `t` switching the tabs while a pane has the keyboard; toasts for a task done, blocked or gone silent; a few words of each reply drawn in colour where the model marks them ({{r:…}} red, {{o:…}} orange, {{v:…}} green, {{p:…}} pink), the convention given in one system prompt section. No tool, no refusal; KODFLOW_COLORS=off turns off the colours and the section.

silentMinutes.title: Silent after (minutes)
silentMinutes.description: A task in progress with no activity from its worker for this long is flagged silent and toasted once.

autoOpen.title: Open the panes at start
autoOpen.description: Open the Tasks pane when a session starts, and the Agents tab while a subagent runs (closed with the last one). The engine seats an unasked pane only from 144 columns; /hud opens them at any width.

ci.title: CI of cited pull requests
ci.description: Every 5 minutes at most, ask gh pr checks about the GitHub pull request URLs that an open task cites, and show the result beside the task.
